changelog: The Mac build jumps from 0.0.100 to 0.0.106, so this covers six releases. Buildings reworked: Build and conjure cards are One-Shot until upgraded, the Engineer reclaims half his Builds, the Warlord brings a Barracks and the Nomad a Walking Base, with Prefab Yards and Live Grid as doctrines. Start buildings deploy with the army. The after-battle report now shows how the fight went, then the spoils, then the draft. Act IV's climax has a proper entrance, a wide road to it, and stays in sight once it appears; it also absorbs the Act IV boss you just beat. Chain of Command on a card that takes a target leaves a free One-Shot copy in your hand to aim somewhere else. Surge makes every building act again: depots draw, barracks muster a Rifleman. Late-game medal rewards offer a much wider spread instead of the same few. Hit & Run scales with the hits that unit has landed. A won Refugee Escort now lets the refugee ask to join as a Bannerman, Rifleman or Rocket Soldier rather than walking into your roster as a civilian. Every large card view has a Show upgrade checkbox that puts the card beside what it becomes, and the choice is remembered. Card text is rules only now, with the flavor flourishes stripped. Menus run the full height of the screen behind a single see-through bottom bar, the run forecast finally has a way out, and a win that opens a new Ascension tier says so on the run-end screen. Esc and Back share one path that closes the top panel and never strands a run; an unanswered confirm answers no instead of locking End Turn for the battle. Around 25 cards whose text promised something different from what they did were corrected, and a 3,520-run fuzz sweep fixed spawn, tile and upgrade breaks. Card faces no longer leave holes in the Collection when the browser's encoder gives up. Forward Scouts reveals every uncleared ? node, not just the next row. Mac: universal (Apple Silicon and Intel), Developer ID signed, notarized and stapled. Minimum macOS 11. 1,295 tests.
